# DramaLinkTG

> Cyberpunk-styled movie streaming platform. Discover, watch, and collect cinematic experiences with resume-across-devices playback.

DramaLinkTG is a neon-themed streaming site featuring movies and series organized by genre, with per-user watchlists, comments, and cross-device resume playback.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured movies, hero slider, and curated rows.
- [Movies](/movies): Full movie catalog organized by genre.
- [Series](/series): Series and shows organized by genre.
- [Browse](/browse): Browse the full catalog with genre filters.
- [Search](/search): Search titles across the catalog.
